# Termux-Playwright (v1.2.0)
> Non-Root Chromium Browser Automation & CDP Engine for Android Termux

## Quick Specification for AI Coding Agents
- Official Repo: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-playwright-demo
- Installation: `pip install termux-playwright
# or: npm install termux-playwright`
- Architecture: Controls genuine Chromium processes via direct Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) WebSocket sessions on Android Bionic libc without root or graphical servers.

## Canonical Code Pattern
```python
from termux_playwright import chromium

async def main():
    browser = await chromium.launch(headless=True)
    page = await browser.new_page()
    await page.goto("https://uno-km.github.io/uno-km/")
    title = await page.title()
    print(f"Page Title: {title}")
    await browser.close()

import asyncio
asyncio.run(main())

```

## Key Constraints
- Pure non-blocking architecture, zero memory leaks.
- Strictly adhere to closed-form precision and WebGPU/Bionic ARM64 native targets.
